function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the current temperature in Moscow right now.  
You can quickly check the latest weather (in Celsius) by visiting a weather website such as [weather.com](https://weather.com), using a weather app, or querying a weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap, WeatherAPI, or the official Russian meteorological service).

We can approximate or say we can't fetch real-time. We can suggest using a weather API. But we can also provide a placeholder. According to policy, we should not hallucinate.
